details.youth_clubs: New York Soccer Club (01/2012-12/2014), New York City FC (01/2015–2019), Borussia Dortmund (2019-1/2020)
details.further_information: The transfer fee can increase by up to €3 million to a total of €7 million through bonus payments. Dortmund also secured a 15% share of any future transfer profits. His paternal grandfather is from Argentina and his paternal grandmother is from Portugal. Giovanni Reyna is the son of Danielle Egan (former US national team player). Giovanni Reyna is the son of Claudio Reyna (Strategic Advisor Austin FC).Giovanni Reyna is the brother of Joah Reyna (Michigan Wolverines (University of Michigan)).
